title: 6061-T6511 Flat Bar: Sizes, Weights, Tolerances, and How to Order It
summary: 6061-T6511 flat bar is extruded rectangular aluminum bar, stress relieved by stretching, to ASTM B221. Complete size and weight-per-foot tables, mechanical minimums, and what to specify.
body_markdown:
### How much does 6061-T6511 flat bar weigh per foot?


Multiply thickness by width in inches by 1.17. A 1 x 4 inch bar is 4.68 pounds per foot and a 0.5 x 2 inch bar is 1.17. Distributor tables using a density of 0.098 rather than 0.0975 will read about half a percent heavier.


### Is 6061-T6511 flat bar the same as 6061-T6 flat bar?


T6511 is T6 that has additionally been stress relieved by stretching and lightly straightened. Mechanical minimums are the same, but the stress relief matters if you are machining the bar, because unrelieved material moves when you remove metal from one side.


### What is the difference between flat bar and rectangular bar?


Nothing. They are two names for the same extruded rectangular section. Some catalogues split them by size, calling narrow sections flat bar and wider or thicker ones rectangular bar, but the product and the specification are identical.


### Is aluminum flat bar flat?


Not to a machined standard. Commercial extruded bar carries Aluminum Association allowances for straightness, twist and flatness, and a long thin section can use a lot of that allowance. If flatness drives your part, specify precision or manifold quality, or buy plate cut to size.


### Can I get flat bar in a size that is not standard?


Yes, by cutting it from plate. A rectangle cut from 6061-T651 plate weighs exactly the same as bar of identical dimensions and can be any thickness and width we stock, which is 0.25 to 10 inches thick. It also carries the higher 42,000 psi ultimate minimum.
